pokedexEntries.x: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

pokedexEntries.or: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.

pokedexEntries.y: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It swoops out of the dark to attack.

pokedexEntries.as: The ultrasonic waves it emits from its ears can reduce a large boulder to pebbles. It swoops out of the dark to attack.

pokedexEntries.us: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.

pokedexEntries.um: This hot-blooded Pokémon attacks anything it sees with ultrasonic waves that can crush boulders.

pokedexEntries.sw: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.

pokedexEntries.sh: Flying through the darkness, it weakens enemies with ultrasonic waves that could crush stone. Its fangs finish the fight.

pokedexEntries.sc: Ultrasonic waves emitted by a Noivern can pulverize a large boulder. This Pokémon has a cruel disposition.

pokedexEntries.vi: In the dark, even Hydreigon are terrified of this Pokémon. But in the light, Noivern is the one that avoids battle.

pokedexEntries.za: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
